verdict.rationale: Firebase exposes much of its management surface programmatically. The official CLI deploys code and assets, works with database data, and imports/exports Auth users. The official MCP server can create and manage projects, manage Auth users, and work with Firestore data, and the Admin SDK and an HTTP API are also mentioned. However, nothing in the pack claims API/UI parity: no OpenAPI spec was found, and some features such as Gemini in Firebase are described only as a chat interface in the console. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee, a published machine-readable API spec covering console functionality, programmatic coverage of console-only features like Gemini insights, and independent corroboration of parity.
